dedupe_keys.name: membrane based processes to obtain high quality water from brewery wastewater

description: The pilot compares ultrafiltration plus reverse osmosis against ozonation, coagulation, ceramic microfiltration and reverse osmosis for secondary brewery wastewater. The authors evaluate operating settings, fouling control, cleaning-in-place and final water quality. They report ultrafiltration fluxes of 25–30 litres per square metre per hour and ceramic microfiltration up to 120, with different cleaning and coagulation requirements. The source states compliance with its cited Spanish reuse limits, which is retained as a study claim and not checked against present regulations. The separately catalogued cleaning supplement supports the case. Exact site, observation dates and generalization to other breweries remain unknown. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
